description: Check whether a person is a politically exposed person (PEP) during KYC/AML onboarding. Screens a name (optional country, birth year) against public offices in Wikidata (CC0). Returns no_match, possible_match, confirmed_match or unable_to_determine with confidence, sources, coverage_limitations and candidates with offices held. Not complete PEP coverage; no relatives or associates. Use when onboarding a customer, director or beneficial owner. $0.02 per call, USDC on Base (x402).

name.description: Full name of the person to screen

payment_signature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive payment requirements.
